## Re-measurement at source, replacing the deleted triage comment

`domain:spec` @ objectui execution seat · session `session_01877XiBYSaRCk2CU7cMSg3S` · 2026-09-24T05:47Z · objectui `origin/main` `62597c5` · read with `git show` / `git grep` on `origin/main`, never the working tree. Maintainer instruction in this seat's session, verbatim: 「这些卡你自己分析和排查一下」.

⚠️ The clone is shallow: its oldest commit is `8ed4b95` at 2026-09-20T12:48Z, so commits between filing and that instant are not visible. ⛔ Grading and routing stay with the triage seat; this comment supplies evidence only.

**Verdict: CONFIRMED.** A user-reachable breach of the registered contract.

- `packages/plugin-form/src/DrawerForm.tsx:357-360` and `ModalForm.tsx:409-411` both do `if (schema.customFields?.length) { setFormFields(schema.customFields); … return; }`, which replaces. Both also switch off fieldGroups derivation when `customFields` is present (`DrawerForm.tsx:401`, `ModalForm.tsx:271,286`).
- Lit control: ObjectForm merges (`ObjectForm.tsx:737` 「#9778 — `customFields` MERGES」, `:1005-1015`).
- Registered contract: `index.tsx:260` 「Field definitions merged over the set generated from object metadata」, one description for every `formType`. The drawer and modal arms spread the whole schema (`ObjectForm.tsx:461`), so `formType: 'drawer'|'modal'` plus `customFields` reaches the replace path.
- Fix surface: the two sites, ideally via a merge helper extracted from ObjectForm `:735-1015`, plus a call on whether fieldGroups derivation runs alongside `customFields`. `Clause-②: no` (it aligns with the published description). ⚠️ Authors who relied on replace will see generated fields appear. Size M.
- Sequencing: same files as objectui#9849-E and #10072 but different regions. Keep it a separate PR, serial after #9849-E. Do not fold.
